inspection.title: AI inspection
inspection.intro: Have the model inspect the logs this query matches: an overview of volume and levels over time, what is abnormal, what spiked, what is new, and where to look next.
inspection.requirements_hint: Optional. Without it the logs are inspected as a whole.
inspection.requirements_placeholder: For example: only payment-service in production; treat USER_CANCEL as an expected outcome; when a new stack trace appears, break it down by release.
inspection.disclosure: The inspection sends query results of these logs to the AI model {{model}}.

prompt.task: Inspect the log stream “{{stream}}” and write an inspection report in English.
prompt.query: Look only at the logs that match this query: {{statement}}
prompt.query_all: Inspect every log of the stream in this time range.
prompt.steps: Read the data of this time range yourself with the log query tools you have. In the conclusion, sum up the volume of logs, the share of each level and whether the whole looks healthy. As evidence, list one by one: how the volume and the levels change over time, the main kinds of errors and warnings with when each first appeared and the services involved, any clear spike, and new or rare patterns worth attention. Then give the likely causes, and the next steps ordered by severity.
prompt.rules: Analyse read-only: change nothing. Every finding must rest on a query result; where no data can be read, say so instead of guessing.
prompt.digest_one: What the {{count}} log loaded on the page says (a place to begin, not the whole):
prompt.digest_other: What the {{count}} logs loaded on the page say (a place to begin, not the whole):
